5. Check what fields are extracted/computed from memo content

Report the computation site, what triggers recomputation, and what properties are extracted.

- dataviz: Use this skill whenever you are about to create ANY chart, graph, plot, dashboard, or data visualization, in ANY output medium — an HTML or React artifact, inline SVG, plotting code in any library (matplotlib, plotly, d3, Recharts, …), an image/PNG you will render and upload, or a chart shared into Slack. Read it BEFORE writing the first line of chart code, choosing chart colors, building a stat tile / meter / KPI row, or laying out a dashboard. Produces visualizations that read as one system — elegant, accessible, consistent in light and dark — using a brand-neutral placeholder palette you swap for your own. Automated behaviors ("from now on when X", "each time X", "whenever X", "before/after X") require hooks configured in settings.json - the harness executes these, not Claude, so memory/preferences cannot fulfill them. Also use for: permissions ("allow X", "add permission", "move permission to"), env vars ("set X=Y"), hook troubleshooting, or any changes to settings.json/settings.local.json files. Examples: "allow npm commands", "add bq permission to global settings", "move permission to user settings", "set DEBUG=true", "when claude stops show X". content.text:
The `memopayload.Runner.RunOnce` is defined but not wired into the server startup at this time -- it exists as a batch utility. The primary callers of `RebuildMemoPayload` are the two call sites in `memo_service.go`.

Now let me check the proto definition to confirm the structure.

I now have the complete picture. Here is the report.

---

## Derived Memo Metadata: Computation, Triggers, and Extracted Properties

### Computation Site

The computation happens in two layers:

1. **Orchestrator**: `RebuildMemoPayload` in `/bench/home/work/server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` (line 74). It calls `markdownService.ExtractAll(memo.Content)` and writes the result into `memo.Payload.Tags` and `memo.Payload.Property`.

2. **Extraction engine**: `ExtractAll` in `/bench/home/work/internal/markdown/markdown.go` (line 356). This parses the memo's markdown content into a goldmark AST and walks it in a single pass, collecting all derived metadata at once.

### Operations That Trigger Recomputation

Three operations call `RebuildMemoPayload`:

| Operation | File | Line | When |
|---|---|---|---|
| **CreateMemo** | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | 108 | Every new memo, before it is persisted |
| **UpdateMemo** (content path) | `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` | 447 | Only when the `"content"` field is in the update mask |
| **Runner.RunOnce** (batch) | `server/runner/memopayload/runner.go` | 52 | Batch rebuild of all memos (processes in batches of 100); defined but not currently wired into server startup |

Notably, updates that change only visibility, pinned state, location, or timestamps do **not** trigger payload recomputation -- it fires only when the content field changes.

### What the Computation Extracts

The single AST walk in `ExtractAll` produces an `ExtractedData` struct with three fields:

**1. Tags** (`[]string`) -- All `#tag` nodes found in the markdown, deduplicated while preserving original case. Tags inside link or image nodes are excluded (see `isTagNodeInLinkOrImage`).

**2. Mentions** (`[]string`) -- All `@mention` nodes, lowercased and deduplicated. (These are extracted by `ExtractAll` but not written into the payload by `RebuildMemoPayload`; they are used elsewhere for mention-notification dispatch.)

**3. Property** (`MemoPayload_Property`) -- Five computed boolean/string fields derived from the AST node types encountered:

| Field | What it detects | AST node kind |
|---|---|---|
| `HasLink` (bool) | Content contains a markdown link | `gast.KindLink` |
| `HasTaskList` (bool) | Content contains GFM task checkboxes | `east.KindTaskCheckBox` |
| `HasCode` (bool) | Content contains code blocks or inline code | `gast.KindCodeBlock`, `KindFencedCodeBlock`, `KindCodeSpan` |
| `HasIncompleteTasks` (bool) | At least one unchecked task checkbox exists | `east.TaskCheckBox` where `IsChecked == false` |
| `Title` (string) | Plain text of the first block-level H1 heading | First direct child of Document that is `gast.Heading` with `Level == 1` |

These properties are stored in the `MemoPayload` protobuf (defined at `/bench/home/work/proto/store/memo.proto`, line 14) alongside the `Location` field, which is user-set (not derived from content) and handled separately during create/update operations.
